properties.name: Harappa
properties.notes: Type site. Detailed mound gazetteer in mound_areas.geojson.

properties.name: Mohenjo-daro
properties.notes: Largest known Indus city. Seal tabulation parser pending.

properties.name: Rakhigarhi
properties.notes: Possibly the largest Indus site by area; excavations ongoing.

properties.name: Kalibangan
properties.notes: Ghaggar-Hakra (Saraswati) belt; pre-Harappan and Harappan phases.

properties.name: Dholavira
properties.notes: Kachchh; famous water management systems and signboard inscription.

properties.name: Lothal
properties.notes: Port town with dockyard; bead-making center.

properties.harappan_connection: Indus seals, ivory objects, and carnelian beads excavated; BMAC-Harappan trade contact (Sarianidi).
properties.name: Gonur Tepe
properties.notes: BMAC (Oxus civilization) capital in Margiana, Turkmenistan. Key evidence for Indus-Central Asia contact.

properties.harappan_connection: Indus seals and sealings found in Mesopotamian context; Meluhha trade (Woolley excavations).
properties.name: Ur
properties.notes: Sumerian city; Indus (Meluhha) merchant presence attested.

properties.harappan_connection: Entrepot for Indus-Mesopotamia Gulf trade; Indus-related weights and seals.
properties.name: Dilmun (Bahrain)
properties.notes: Persian Gulf trade hub linking Meluhha (Indus) and Mesopotamia.

properties.name: Shortugai
properties.notes: Northernmost Harappan outpost (Afghanistan); lapis lazuli trade.
